all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
Isaiah 12:2
Quote of the Day
"Jesus Christ lives and is actively blessing all who seek Him."
President Dieter F. Uchtdorf | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
